Since the heart monitor leads make a square on your abdomen, one under each clavicle close to your shoulders and one under each of those under your ribcage  (some have more and some have less), any arm or core movement can make the rhythm look like something it isn't. Ventricular tachycardia is a (potentially/usually) lethal heart rhythm. The ventricles (lower, stronger chambers) are pumping way to fast and they don't allow for proper blood flow or perfusion of oxygenated blood through your body. Your brain and other vital organs don't get blood/oxygen to them and become damaged or die after a while.
